test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, symbol series and answer the question.

L J + K - Y % T # U P

If all symbols are dropped from the series, which letter will be at the middle most position in the newly formed series ?
solution:
L J + K - Y % T # U P

If all symbols are dropped from the series, then the newly formed series will be:

L J K **Y** T U P

Clearly, Y is at the middle most position in the newly formed series.

Hence, ‘**Y**’ is the correct answer.
